facility_selector_cards.badges_mandatory: Every facility displays: FREE vs PAID hourly tag, availability dot (Green/Orange), and part counter.
facility_selector_cards.card_interactions: Clicking 'Select & Book' highlights active facility, opens part picker and date/time selector with smooth scroll.

rules: 1. Facility & Part selection dropdown/pill group (e.g., Astro -> Full vs Cage 1/2/3).
2. Date picker (default today, quick toggles: Today, Tomorrow, Saturday, Sunday, or calendar).
3. Start Time selector (07:00 to 22:00 in 15-min increments: e.g., 18:00, 18:15, 18:30).
4. Duration picker: 1h min, 15-min steps up to 4h30m (e.g. 1h 00m, 1h 15m, 1h 30m, 2h 00m... up to 4h 30m).
5. Visual Availability Timeline: Shows a 15-minute visual strip for the selected pitch with clear 'Available' (emerald), 'Booked' (slate), and 'Maintenance/Blocked' (diagonal pattern).
6. Repeat Booking Toggle: 'Repeat weekly on this day' with dropdown for 2 to 8 weeks.
7. Pricing Calculator: Real-time calculation showing: Duration x Rate = Total (or €0.00 FREE for back/training/juvenile).

guest_vs_account.guest_tab: Book as Guest: Full Name, Email Address, Contact Phone, Team/Organization notes.
guest_vs_account.member_tab: Club Member Sign-In: Quick login for registered Walterstown coaches and members to auto-fill details and sync past history.

payment_step.trigger: If Total > €0 (e.g. Astro or Gym squad session), show Stripe Card Payment modal/component with Card Number, Expiry, CVC, Postcode, and 'Pay & Submit Request' button.
payment_step.free_flow: If Total == €0, show 'Submit Free Club Booking Request' with 0 payment friction.

checkout_and_auth_flow.feedback_toast: Uses sonner toast notifications for: Request Submitted, Booking Approved, Admin Block Created, Settings Updated.

booking_status_tracker.purpose: Users can check any booking by reference ID (e.g. WGFC-8821) or their email address.

status_badges.requested: Pending Admin Review (Yellow/Blue badge) — Email notice sent to Walterstown pitch coordinator.
status_badges.approved: Pitch Confirmed & Locked (Green badge) — Floodlights and gate schedule ready.
status_badges.declined: Declined with club officer note (e.g., County championship clash or waterlogged pitch).

admin_dashboard.auth_barrier: Secure Admin Login modal/view (Passcode or Admin email/password with demo quick-fill).
admin_navigation: Incoming Booking Requests (Approve/Decline with custom note)
Facility & Part Manager (Edit rates, notes, photos, active status)
Block Off Slots (Pitch maintenance, grass seeding, county fixtures)
Club Alert Settings (Set alert notification email, booking policy disclaimer)
admin_dashboard.table_ux: High-density clean table with quick filters: 'All', 'Pending Approval', 'Approved', 'Paid', 'Declined', 'Blocked'.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Follow the Walterstown GFC identity: 'The Blacks' - Black, White, Emerald Pitch Green accents, Meath Gold badges. Never look like a generic corporate SaaS. This is a proud 1902 Irish GAA club.
2. All files are in React .js (NOT .tsx). Ensure JSX syntax is pure .js/.jsx compatible.

3. Mandatory data-testid attributes on ALL buttons, inputs, facility cards, filter pills, slot items, and modal triggers (e.g. data-testid='facility-card-astro', data-testid='slot-picker-date', data-testid='submit-booking-button', data-testid='admin-approve-btn-WGFC-101').

4. Implement all 6 facilities specified in problem statement: Astro (Full, Cage 1/2/3), Main Pitch (Full, Top Half, Second Half), Back Pitch (Full, Half Stafford's Side, Half Boland's Side), Training Pitch (Full, Area 1, Area 2), Juvenile Pitch, Gym (Full squad, individual slot).
5. Slot picker must strictly support: min 1h, 15-minute increments up to ~4h30m, and repeat booking up to 8 weeks.
6. Make availability obvious at a glance: visual timeline bar showing available vs booked vs blocked slots for the selected pitch.
7. Clear distinct badges for FREE vs PAID slots, and status badges (Requested -> Approved / Declined).
8. Mock Stripe payment modal for paid slots with realistic card input, card brand detection icon, and simulated processing state with receipt summary.

9. Admin dashboard must include: Approve/Decline actions with note, Block off slots modal (e.g., pitch maintenance or Meath championship match), Facility editor (rates, notes, photos), and Settings (alert email).

10. Provide sample pre-seeded bookings (e.g. Walterstown Senior Men, Under-15 Camogie, Nursery Saturday Morning, Local 5-a-side) so the calendar and status tracker look populated immediately on first load.
11. Mobile first responsiveness: Ensure full booking wizard is smooth on mobile phones (sticky booking summary on mobile, large tap targets >= 44px).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Do NOT use default centered AI layouts with generic purple/blue gradients. Use bold athletic typography, crisp black/white/emerald GAA club palette, textured badges, and strong optical alignment.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.transitions: Never use 'transition: all'. Explicitly use 'transition: color 0.15s, background-color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s'.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.header_transparency: Header MUST NOT be completely transparent. Use 'bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200' to guarantee 100% legibility over any scroll content.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toast_library: Use Sonner for toasts (sonner import available in package.json).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.icons: Use lucide-react (installed: 0.516.0). Never use AI emoji icons like 🤖🧠💡 for club buttons. Use authentic sport icons (Calendar, Clock, Shield, MapPin, CheckCircle, AlertTriangle, CreditCard, Lock, Users, Dumbbell, Sparkles).
